result.summary: The intersection is equipped with basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked zebra crosswalks, sidewalks, and traffic signals. However, the environment lacks visible dedicated pedestrian signal heads and features a relatively wide crossing distance without a refuge island, which increases exposure to vehicular traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Exposure
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the entire width of the roadway without a median refuge, increasing time spent in the path of vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway at the marked zebra crosswalk.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated walk/don't-walk signals are visible, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicular traffic lights which may not provide adequate clearance time.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection corners where pedestrian signals would typically be mounted.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection corners can block the visibility between drivers and pedestrians entering the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the cross street along the curb.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to improve clarity and safety for people crossing.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the crosswalks to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: This residential intersection features marked zebra crosswalks and a traffic signal, providing basic pedestrian infrastructure. However, the absence of dedicated pedestrian signal heads and the relatively wide street width increase exposure risk for people crossing.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: No visible pedestrian signal heads are present at this signalized intersection to indicate safe crossing intervals.

hazards.name: Wide turning radius
hazards.description: The corner geometry appears wide, which can encourage higher vehicle turning speeds through the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner of the intersection near the school sign

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear guidance on remaining crossing time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and reduce vehicle turning speeds at the intersection.

result.summary: The image depicts a residential intersection with basic pedestrian infrastructure, including marked zebra crosswalks and sidewalks. However, the environment lacks advanced safety features like curb extensions or pedestrian signals, and sightlines are partially obstructed by parked vehicles.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars near the intersection corners block sightlines between approaching drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb on the right side of the intersection.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: Trash and recycling bins placed on the sidewalk narrow the accessible path for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: On the sidewalk to the left of the foreground.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalks to improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and physically prevent parking too close to the intersection.

interventions.title: Tactile Warning Surfaces
interventions.description: Add detectable warning pads to the curb ramps to improve accessibility for visually impaired pedestrians.

result.summary: This is a signalized four-way intersection with high-visibility continental crosswalks and curb ramps. While basic pedestrian infrastructure is present, the wide roadway and lack of median refuge islands increase exposure time for pedestrians crossing multiple lanes.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four lanes of traffic without a median refuge, increasing exposure to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground and center.

hazards.name: Roadway Pavement Cracking
hazards.description: Significant longitudinal cracking and patching in the intersection pavement.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle green light.
